title: Harlem Artist BJizzle's Music Is A Vibe Check New Single 'Thuggin'
htmlContent:
Harlem Artist BJizzle's Music Is A Vibe Check New Single 'Thuggin'. Harlem, New York's rising star BJizzle is the CEO And Founder of Money Up Front Sound Label. Being from Harlem, he listened to Jay Z, Big L, Mase Jadakiss, Drake, Meek Mill, Cam, Vado, and Rip Huddy 6.

These are also the artists that he drew inspiration from growing up. B Jizzle came up on the same block as Dirty Kitchen And Grinis Grills. The 26-year-old has already landed a feature with Dave East on a single called Baker Done off his project 'Views From The 3rd." The single has close to 50k streams on Spotify.

Earlier this month, BJizzle dropped a new single called 'Thuggin' which features Richie Rozay. The song is a vibe and is something that I can have in rotation and on repeat for hours.

Thuggin is the follow to the 'My Side' video that BJizzle dropped in November.

According to BJizzle, he has been rapping since the age of eighteen and see music as an outlet and it's very therapeutic.

Per, BJizzle's Instagram, he has a video called 'Lottery Ticket' coming soon.

Make sure you stay tapped in with BJizzle on Instragram for the latest updates.
